quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026) capital expenditure totaled JPY 32,708 million, most of it at the parent company (JPY 29,062 million); the main items were a JPY 10,312 million construction down payment for the Gohara plant and a JPY 3,632 million construction down payment for the Haneda R&D Center. Funded from the company's own cash.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 capex JPY 32,708 million (parent JPY 29,062 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Planned new facility: Gohara plant (Kure, Hiroshima), production facilities for precision processing equipment and precision processing tools; total planned investment JPY 35,900 million, of which JPY 12,873 million already paid; self-funded; construction started February 2026, completion scheduled for April 2028. The company states the main purpose is stronger business continuity and rationalization investment, and that production capacity will increase after completion.

quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Planned new facility: Haneda R&D Center (Ota-ku, Tokyo), R&D and other facilities; total planned investment JPY 12,800 million, of which JPY 4,515 million already paid; self-funded; started September 2025, completion scheduled for December 2027. The company states R&D capacity will increase after completion.

quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 R&D expenses totaled JPY 34,156 million, covering precision processing equipment, precision processing tools (consumables) and application technology for microfabrication of semiconductors and electronic components. The company states customers' precision-processing needs keep growing as end products become smaller and higher-performance, so it is actively hiring engineers in abrasive, laser and software technology, and it is also actively developing processing for materials other than silicon as that need grows.

quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mid-to-long-term targets: a 4-year cumulative consolidated ordinary profit margin of 20% or more and a 4-year cumulative RORA (return on risk assets) of 20% or more. At FY2026 the 4-year cumulative ordinary profit margin was 41.4% (40.0% a year earlier), meeting the 20% target for the 10th consecutive year; 4-year cumulative RORA was 51.2%.
quarterly_data.figure: 4-year cumulative ordinary margin 41.4% vs 20% target; RORA 51.2%

quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management expects the uses of its Kiru-Kezuru-Migaku (cutting, grinding, polishing) technology to expand in fields related to AI, IoT and autonomous driving as information and communication technology advances, and expects demand for its products to grow over the medium to long term as semiconductor demand rises with the transition to a decarbonized society.
